author: Ari Koslow
title: Keshad Johnson to become unrestricted free agent
desc: The Heat will not extend a qualifying offer to Keshad Johnson.
impact: The reigning Slam Dunk Contest champion will become an unrestricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tari Eason to become restricted free agent
desc: Houston is extending a qualifying offer to Tari Eason.
impact: Eason will become a restricted free agent this offseason. He is likely to remain in Houston.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JD Davison has team option picked up by Rockets
desc: The Rockets picked up the $2.6 million team option on guard J.D. Davison.
impact: Davison will remain in a reserve role for Houston. He is off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Smart declines player option with Lakers
desc: Marcus Smart declined his $5.4 million player option with the Lakers.
impact: Smart will enter unrestricted free agency. He is expected to draw interest from the Rockets.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Olivier-Maxence Prosper has team option picked up by Grizzlies
desc: The Grizzlies are picking up the $2.5 million team option for Olivier-Maxence Prosper.
impact: Prosper will remain in a reserve role for Memphis. He is off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: GG Jackson II has team option exercised by Grizzlies
desc: GG Jackson had his $2.4 million team option exercised for next season by the Grizzlies.
impact: Jackson was able to show flashes of his upside last season for a Grizzlies rotation that was super banged up during the second half of the year. He averaged 12.5 points on 50 percent shooting from the field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Nembhard has team option exercised by Mavericks
desc: Ryan Nembhard had his $2.2 million team option exercised for next season by the Mavericks.
impact: Nembhard made 27 starts over 60 appearances last season in Dallas. He will remain in a reserve role behind Kyrie Irving.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Wiggins opts into player option with Heat
desc: Andrew Wiggins has opted in for his $30.1 million salary this 2026-27 season with the Heat.
impact: This move was expected by Wiggins. He will look to help out Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo as the new look Heat attempt to make a deep run next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trendon Watford has team option declined by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are not picking up the team option of Trendon Watford.
impact: Watford will become an unrestricted free agent. He will seek a depth role with another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalen Terry has team option picked up by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are picking up the team option of Dalen Terry.
impact: Terry figures to remain in a depth role and off the fantasy radar for the 76ers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominick Barlow has team option exercised by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are picking up the team option of Dominick Barlow.
impact: Barlow figures to remain in a depth role and off the fantasy radar for the 76ers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trayce Jackson-Davis has team option exercised by Raptors
desc: Trayce Jackson-Davis had his $2.4 million team option exercised for next season by the Raptors.
impact: Jackson-Davis will remain in a reserve role for Toronto and off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Malachi Smith has team option exercised by Nets
desc: The Brooklyn Nets are exercising the team option on guard Malachi Smith.
impact: The deal is fully non-guaranteed for the 2026-27 season. Smith will remain in a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Deandre Ayton opting into player option with Lakers
desc: Deandre Ayton is opting into his $8.1 million player option with the Lakers.
impact: Ayton had a very up-and-down season in his first year with the Lakers. He'll figure to remain in a similar role heading into his second season with the team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luguentz Dort has team option exercised by Thunder
desc: The Thunder are exercising Luguentz Dort's $17.7 million team option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: The Thunder are continuing to explore trade options for Dort. It seems likely he will be on the move.
